- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  // apps/web/components/tasks/TaskGroups.tsx ("use client")
  export type TaskLevel = "low" | "medium" | "high";          // same values as convex/tasks.ts taskEnergyValidator / taskPriorityValidator
  export type TaskStep = { id: string; text: string; done: boolean };
  export type TaskItem = {
    id: string;                 // passed back in callbacks; never rendered
    title: string;              // user text, dir="auto"
    done: boolean;
    energy: TaskLevel;          // shown as Quiet / Steady / Push
    priority: TaskLevel;        // shown as Low / Normal / High priority
    minutes: number | null;     // planned length in whole minutes; null → not shown
    dueDate: string | null;     // "YYYY-MM-DD" local day; shown only in the "week" and "later" groups
    dueTime: string | null;     // "HH:MM" 24-hour; shown as "before HH:MM" in the "today" group when not done
    doneTime: string | null;    // "HH:MM" when done today; shown after the Done chip
    steps: TaskStep[];          // checklist; [] → no checklist
  };
  export type TaskGroupKey = "today" | "week" | "checklists" | "later";
  export type TaskGroup = { key: TaskGroupKey; tasks: TaskItem[] };
  export type TaskGroupsProps = {
    groups: TaskGroup[];        // any subset, rendered in the order today, week, checklists, later; a group with 0 tasks is not rendered
    laterShown: number;         // tasks of "later" currently in `groups`
    laterTotal: number;         // all "later" tasks; LoadMore shows only when laterShown < laterTotal
    loadingMore?: boolean;      // passed to LoadMore `loading`
    onToggle: (args: { taskId: string }) => void;
    onToggleStep: (args: { taskId: string; stepId: string }) => void;
    onOpen: (args: { taskId: string }) => void;
    onLoadMore: () => void;
  };
  export function TaskGroups(props: TaskGroupsProps): JSX.Element;
  ```
  Layout (composes existing tempo.css classes; no stylesheet): root `<div className="tp-section" data-component="TaskGroups">` (`.tp-section` is the existing grid with `--tp-space-3` gap; the design page's local `tk-groups` class is not in tempo.css and is not used) holding one `<section className="tp-section" data-component="Section" data-group={key} aria-labelledby={headingId}>` per non-empty group (`headingId` from `React.useId()` + key). Section head `<div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id={headingId}>{title}</h2>{count}</div>` where `count` is `<span className="tp-section__count">` holding `copy.openCount` with `{n}` in `<span className="tp-num">` (n = tasks with `done === false`) for "today" and "week", `copy.laterSub` for "later", nothing for "checklists". Rows sit in `<ul className="tp-block-task" role="list" data-component="TaskBlock">`; the "checklists" group wraps each of its tasks in `<div className="tp-card" data-check-card>` holding a one-row `ul.tp-block-task`. Row: `<li className="tp-task-row" data-component="TaskRow" data-done={done ? "true" : "false"}>` → (1) `<button type="button" className="tp-check" aria-pressed={done} aria-label={done ? copy.markOpen : copy.markDone (with {title} filled)} onClick={() => onToggle({ taskId: id })}><span className="tp-check__box"><TpIcon name="check" /></span></button>`; (2) `<div className="tp-task-row__body"><span className="tp-task-row__title" dir="auto">{title}</span><span className="tp-task-row__meta">…</span></div>`; (3) `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--sm tp-btn--icon" aria-label={copy.edit with {title}} onClick={() => onOpen({ taskId: id })}><TpIcon name="edit" size="sm" /></button>`. Meta, in this order, each only when its data exists: when `done`: `<span className="tp-chip tp-chip--done">{copy.done}</span>` then `doneTime` in `<span className="tp-num tp-mono">`; when not done: in "week"/"later" with `dueDate` → `<span>{copy.dow[weekday]} <span className="tp-num">{day}</span></span>` (weekday from `new Date(dueDate + "T00:00:00Z").getUTCDay()`, day = `Number(dueDate.slice(8))`); in "today" with `dueTime` → `<span>{copy.before} <span className="tp-num tp-mono">{dueTime}</span></span>`; `minutes` → `<span><span className="tp-num">{minutes}</span> {copy.min}</span>`; energy chip `<span className="tp-chip"><TpIcon name="energy" size="sm" /><span>{copy.energy[energy]}</span></span>`; priority chip `<span className="tp-chip"><TpIcon name="flag" size="sm" /><span>{copy.priority[priority]}</span></span>`; when `steps.length > 0` → `<span className="tp-checklist__count">` with `copy.stepsDone` (`{done}` and `{total}` each in `.tp-num`). Steps list (any group, rendered inside `.tp-task-row__body` right after the meta span, only when `steps.length > 0`, as `TaskViewsScreen.tsx` does today): `<ul className="tp-checklist" data-component="Checklist" aria-label={copy.stepsOf with {title}}>`, one `<li className="tp-checklist__item"><label className="tp-choice"><input type="checkbox" className="tp-checkbox" checked={step.done} onChange={() => onToggleStep({ taskId: id, stepId: step.id })} /><span className="tp-choice__text tp-checklist__text" dir="auto">{step.text}</span></label></li>` per step. After the "later" section's list, when `laterShown < laterTotal`: `<LoadMore shown={laterShown} total={laterTotal} onLoadMore={onLoadMore} loading={loadingMore} />`.
  Group titles: today `copy.today`, week `copy.week`, checklists `copy.checklists`, later `copy.later`.
  Copy (`COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>>`; `dow`, `energy`, `priority` are nested records in the same constant):

  | key | EN | HE |
  |---|---|---|
  | today | Today | היום |
  | week | This week | השבוע |
  | checklists | Checklists | רשימות תיוג |
  | later | Later | בהמשך |
  | laterSub | No day yet, and that's okay | עוד בלי יום, וזה בסדר |
  | openCount | {n} open | {n} פתוחות |
  | markDone | Mark {title} complete (repo `tasks.markDone`) | סימון המשימה {title} כבוצעה (repo `tasks.markDone`) |
  | markOpen | Mark {title} not done (repo `tasks.markOpen`) | סימון המשימה {title} כפתוחה (repo `tasks.markOpen`) |
  | edit | Edit {title} (repo `tasks.editName`) | עריכת {title} (repo `tasks.editName`) |
  | done | Done (repo `search.status.done`) | בוצע (repo `search.status.done`) |
  | before | before | עד |
  | min | min | דק׳ |
  | stepsDone | {done} of {total} done | {done} מתוך {total} בוצעו |
  | stepsOf | Steps for {title} | השלבים של {title} |
  | energy.low / .medium / .high | Quiet / Steady / Push | שקט / יציב / דחיפה |
  | priority.low / .medium / .high | Low priority / Normal priority / High priority | עדיפות נמוכה / עדיפות רגילה / עדיפות גבוהה |
  | dow.0 … dow.6 (Sun … Sat) | Sun / Mon / Tue / Wed / Thu / Fri / Sat | א׳ / ב׳ / ג׳ / ד׳ / ה׳ / ו׳ / ש׳ |

  `{title}` is filled with `copy.x.replace("{title}", () => title)` (function replacer keeps a `$` in a title literal, as `TaskViewsScreen.tsx` `fillSlot` does). LoadMore's own strings come from TFV2-0101.
  States (harness order): `default` (all four groups: today 3 open + 1 done, week 2, checklists 1 with 5 steps 2 done, later 2 of 5 → LoadMore shown), `later-only` (only "later", laterShown 5 = laterTotal 5 → no LoadMore), `loading-more` (later 2 of 5 with `loadingMore: true`). Empty / loading / error / offline belong to TasksView (TFV2-0128a).
  Harness fixtures (typed `TaskGroupsProps["groups"]`): today = `t1` "Draft 3 slides for Thursday" (steady/high, 25 min), `t2` "Email Dana about the lease" (quiet/medium, 10 min), `t3` "Pick up prescription" (quiet/high, dueTime "18:00"), `t4` "Water the plants" (done, doneTime "08:05", quiet/low); week = `t5` "Call the bank about the deposit" (steady/medium, 15 min, dueDate "2026-10-14"), `t7` "Ask Yoni to borrow his van" (quiet/low, 5 min, dueDate "2026-10-16"); checklists = `t8` "Pack the kitchen" (push/medium, 90 min, dueDate "2026-10-17", steps `s1` "Buy boxes" done, `s2` "Wrap the glasses" done, `s3` "Pack the pans", `s4` "Label each box", `s5` "Clear the fridge"); later = `t9` "Sort old photos" (quiet/low, 30 min), `t10` "Book a haircut" (quiet/low, 5 min). All other fields: `done: false`, `null`, `[]`. Titles are user data and stay English in both languages.
  RTL: logical classes only; in Hebrew the check sits at the right and the edit button at the left; `.tp-num`/`.tp-mono` keep numbers and times LTR. Keyboard: check, steps and edit are native controls in DOM order (check → steps → edit per row); Enter/Space activate; focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` outline. Breakpoints: none of its own (rows wrap meta at 390; same layout at 768/1024/1280). Motion: only Stage 1 transitions (`.tp-task-row` background `--tp-dur-fast`); no entrance animation.

Conflicts (OPEN): after `Edit {title}` those specs expect an inline row editor (`Edit task title`, `Save task`, `Edit priority`, `Edit energy`, `Edit due date`, `New checklist step`, `Add step`, `Remove step {step}` — `task-views-core.spec.ts:35-36`, `tasks-edit.spec.ts:37-43,73-74`) and two-step row delete `Delete {title}` / `Confirm delete {title}` (`tasks-edit.spec.ts:88-89`); the v3 design opens the task sheet instead and has no row delete.

  ```ts
  // apps/web/components/tasks/TasksView.tsx ("use client")
  import type { TaskGroup, TaskLevel } from "@/components/tasks/TaskGroups";
  export type TasksState = "default" | "empty" | "filtered-empty" | "loading" | "error";
  export type TasksFilters = {
    search: string;                         // "" = no search
    energy: "all" | TaskLevel;
    priority: "any" | TaskLevel;
    sort: "due" | "energy" | "minutes";
  };
  export type TasksToast = { id: number; kind: "added" | "done" | "deleted"; undoUntilMs: number }; // "deleted" is used by TFV2-0129b
  export type TasksData = {
    groups: TaskGroup[];                    // passed to TaskGroups as-is
    shownCount: number;                     // tasks visible with the current filters (all groups, before Later's load-more cut)
    laterShown: number;
    laterTotal: number;
    filters: TasksFilters;
    quickAddBusy: boolean;                  // true while the add is in flight
    toast: TasksToast | null;
  };
  export type TasksViewProps = {
    state: TasksState;
    data: TasksData;
    online: boolean;                        // false → StateOffline above the content; everything stays usable
    onQuickAdd: (args: { text: string }) => void;   // text already trimmed and non-empty
    onFiltersChange: (filters: TasksFilters) => void; // the whole next filters object
    onClearFilters: () => void;
    onToggle: (args: { taskId: string }) => void;
    onToggleStep: (args: { taskId: string; stepId: string }) => void;
    onOpen: (args: { taskId: string }) => void;
    onLoadMore: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
    onUndo: () => void;
    onDismissToast: () => void;
  };
  export function TasksView(props: TasksViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```
  Layout, top to bottom, inside `<div className="tp-page tp-page--wide" data-component="TasksView">`:
  1. `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader">` → `<div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title">{copy.title}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{copy.sub}</p></div>` and `<div className="tp-pagehead__actions"><a className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" href="/brain-dump"><TpIcon name="inbox" size="sm" /><span>{copy.dump}</span></a></div>` (all states).
  2. `{!online && <StateOffline />}` (TFV2-0123 default text; all states).
  3. Quick add (states `default`, `empty`, `filtered-empty`; hidden in `loading`/`error` — it stays in `empty` because the empty copy tells the person to use it): `<form className="tp-form tp-surface" data-component="Form" noValidate aria-label={copy.qaLabel} onSubmit=…>` → `<div className="tp-field"><label className="tp-label" htmlFor={inputId}>{copy.qaLabel}</label><div className="tp-toolbar"><input className="tp-input tp-toolbar__grow" id={inputId} type="text" dir="auto" autoComplete="off" placeholder={copy.qaPh} aria-describedby={helpId + (error ? " " + errorId : "")} aria-invalid={error || undefined} value={text} onChange=… /><button className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" type="submit" disabled={data.quickAddBusy} aria-busy={data.quickAddBusy || undefined}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{copy.qaAdd}</span></button></div><p className="tp-help" id={helpId}>{copy.qaHelp}</p>{error && <p className="tp-error-text" id={errorId} role="alert">{copy.qaErr}</p>}</div></form>`. `text` and `error` are local `useState` (UI state only). Submit: `const t = text.trim(); if (!t) { setError(true); focus input; return; } onQuickAdd({ text: t }); setText(""); setError(false);`. Typing clears `error`. Ids from `React.useId()`.
  4. Toolbar (states `default`, `filtered-empty`): `<div className="tp-toolbar" data-component="Toolbar">` with `<SearchInput id={searchId} label={copy.search} value={data.filters.search} onChange={(v) => onFiltersChange({ ...data.filters, search: v })} />` (wrapped in `<div className="tp-toolbar__grow">`), `<Segmented label={copy.energy} options={[{ value: "all", label: copy.all }, { value: "low", label: copy.energyLow }, { value: "medium", label: copy.energyMedium }, { value: "high", label: copy.energyHigh }]} value={data.filters.energy} onChange={(v) => onFiltersChange({ ...data.filters, energy: v as TasksFilters["energy"] })} />`, `<Select id={prioId} label={copy.prio} value={data.filters.priority} options={[{ value: "any", label: copy.prioAny }, { value: "high", label: copy.prioHigh }, { value: "medium", label: copy.prioMedium }, { value: "low", label: copy.prioLow }]} onChange={(v) => onFiltersChange({ ...data.filters, priority: v as TasksFilters["priority"] })} />`, and `<div className="tp-toolbar__end"><SortMenu label={copy.sortLabel} options={[{ value: "due", label: copy.sortDue }, { value: "energy", label: copy.sortEnergy }, { value: "minutes", label: copy.sortMinutes }]} value={data.filters.sort} onChange={(v) => onFiltersChange({ ...data.filters, sort: v as TasksFilters["sort"] })} /></div>`.
  5. Status line (states `default`, `filtered-empty`): `<p className="tp-muted tp-small" role="status">` with `copy.showing`, `{n}` = `data.shownCount` in `<span className="tp-num">`.
  6. Body by state: `default` → `<TaskGroups groups={data.groups} laterShown={data.laterShown} laterTotal={data.laterTotal} onToggle={onToggle} onToggleStep={onToggleStep} onOpen={onOpen} onLoadMore={onLoadMore} />`; `filtered-empty` → `<div className="tp-empty" data-component="Empty"><TpIcon name="filter" size="lg" /><p>{copy.noMatch}</p><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={onClearFilters}><TpIcon name="x" size="sm" /><span>{copy.clear}</span></button></div>`; `empty` → `<StateEmpty title={copy.emptyTitle} body={copy.emptyBody} icon={<TpIcon name="checklist" size="lg" />} action={<a className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" href="/brain-dump"><TpIcon name="inbox" size="sm" /><span>{copy.dump}</span></a>} />`; `loading` → `<StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={6} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={copy.error} onRetry={onRetry} />`.
  7. Toast (any state, when `data.toast !== null`): `<UndoToast key={data.toast.id} toast={{ id: data.toast.id, title: { added: copy.toastAdded, done: copy.toastDone, deleted: copy.toastDeleted }[data.toast.kind], undoUntilMs: data.toast.undoUntilMs, onUndo: async () => onUndo() }} onClose={onDismissToast} />` (existing `apps/web/components/goals/shared.tsx`; its Undo / Dismiss strings are the repo's `gx.toast.undo` "Undo"/"ביטול" and `gx.toast.dismiss` "Dismiss"/"סגירה").

FIXTURES[forced as keyof typeof FIXTURES] : FIXTURES.error; return <TasksView {...fx} online={forced === "offline" ? false : online && fx.online} {...NOOP} />;` (forced mode is display-only: every handler is a no-op and no Convex hook runs, because the data hooks live only in `TasksLive`). Otherwise: `const { isAuthenticated, isLoading } = useConvexAuth(); if (E2E_SIGNED_OUT && !isLoading && !isAuthenticated) return <TaskViewsScreen view="inbox" />;` (today's signed-out local-store screen, unchanged, so `task-views-core.spec.ts` keeps passing — subject to R3-Q1); else `return <ProfileReady fallback={<TasksView {...FIXTURES.loading} online={online} {...NOOP} />}><TasksBoundary online={online}><TasksLive online={online} /></TasksBoundary></ProfileReady>;`.
  - `class TasksBoundary extends Component<{ online: boolean; children: ReactNode }, { failed: boolean; attempt: number }>`: `state = { failed: false, attempt: 0 }`; `static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { failed: true }; }`; `render()` → when `failed`: `<TasksView {...FIXTURES.error} online={this.props.online} {...NOOP} onRetry={() => this.setState((s) => ({ failed: false, attempt: s.attempt + 1 }))} />`; else `<Fragment key={this.state.attempt}>{this.props.children}</Fragment>` (a new key remounts `TasksLive`, which re-subscribes its queries). Convex `useQuery` throws on a server error, which this boundary catches.
  - `TasksLive({ online })`: `const prefs = useQuery(api.preferences.get, {}); const [filters, setFilters] = useState<TasksFilters>({ search: "", energy: "all", priority: "any", sort: "due" }); const rows = useQuery(api.tasks.list, { search: filters.search.trim() || undefined, energy: filters.energy === "all" ? undefined : filters.energy, priority: filters.priority === "any" ? undefined : filters.priority }); const [laterLimit, setLaterLimit] = useState(20); const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false); const [toast, setToast] = useState<TasksToast | null>(null); const undoRef = useRef<(() => Promise<unknown>) | null>(null); const router = useRouter();` and the four mutations `createQuick`, `toggleCompletion`, `update`, `remove` via `useMutation(api.tasks.<name>)`.
  - Derivation (non-exported helpers in page.tsx): `isoInZone(ms, tz)` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: tz, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).format(ms)`; `timeInZone(ms, tz)` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: tz, hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).format(ms)`; `zoneOffsetMs(ms, tz)` = UTC ms of the zone's wall clock at `ms` (from `formatToParts` with `hourCycle: "h23"`, year…second) minus `Math.floor(ms / 1000) * 1000`; `zonedMs(iso, hhmm, tz)` (the UTC ms of wall-clock `iso` `hhmm` in `tz`) = `const u = Date.parse(iso + "T" + hhmm + ":00Z"); return u - zoneOffsetMs(u - zoneOffsetMs(u, tz), tz);`. With `tz = prefs.timeZone`, `today = isoInZone(Date.now(), tz)`, `weekEnd = addDays(today, (prefs.weekStartsOn + 6 - new Date(today + "T00:00:00Z").getUTCDay() + 7) % 7)` (`addDays` from `@/lib/period-pages`). Each row → `TaskItem`: `id: row._id`, `title`, `done: row.status === "done"`, `energy: row.energy ?? "medium"`, `priority`, `minutes: row.timeEstimate && row.timeEstimate > 0 ? Math.round(row.timeEstimate / 60_000) : null`, `dueDate: row.dueAt === undefined ? null : isoInZone(row.dueAt, tz)`, `dueTime: row.dueAt === undefined || timeInZone(row.dueAt, tz) === "23:59" ? null : timeInZone(row.dueAt, tz)` (23:59 is the end-of-day "no time" value the app stores), `doneTime: row.status === "done" && row.completedAt !== undefined ? timeInZone(row.completedAt, tz) : null`, `steps: (row.checklist ?? []).map((c) => ({ id: c.id, text: c.text, done: c.completed }))`. Rows dropped: `status === "cancelled"`; `status === "done"` with no `completedAt` or `isoInZone(completedAt, tz) < today` (done tasks stay until tomorrow). Group: `dueDate !== null && dueDate <= today` → `today` (an earlier open task is shown in Today, never called late); else `steps.length > 0` → `checklists`; else `dueDate !== null && dueDate <= weekEnd` → `week`; else `later`. Inside a group: open before done, then by `filters.sort`: `due` → `dueAt` ascending (none last), `energy` → low, medium, high, then `dueAt`; `minutes` → `minutes` ascending (null last); ties by `title.localeCompare`. `later` is cut to its first `laterLimit`; `laterShown = Math.min(laterLimit, later.length)`, `laterTotal = later.length`; groups with 0 tasks are left out. `shownCount` = all kept rows. `state`: `rows === undefined || prefs === undefined` → `"loading"`; kept rows 0 and filters equal the defaults → `"empty"`; kept rows 0 otherwise → `"filtered-empty"`; else `"default"`.
  - Handlers: `onQuickAdd({ text })` → `setBusy(true); try { const taskId = await createQuick({ title: text, dueAt: zonedMs(addDays(today, 1), "00:00", tz) - 1 }); undoRef.current = () => remove({ taskId }); setToast({ id: Date.now(), kind: "added", undoUntilMs: Date.now() + 300_000 }); } finally { setBusy(false); }` (the new task lands in Today, matching the "Added to Today" toast). `onToggle({ taskId })` → `const r = await toggleCompletion({ taskId: taskId as Id<"tasks"> }); if (r.status === "done") { undoRef.current = () => toggleCompletion({ taskId: taskId as Id<"tasks"> }); setToast({ id: Date.now(), kind: "done", undoUntilMs: Date.now() + 300_000 }); }`. `onToggleStep({ taskId, stepId })` → find the row in `rows`; `await update({ taskId: row._id, checklist: toggleChecklistItem(row.checklist ?? [], stepId) })` (`toggleChecklistItem` from `@/convex/lib/taskChecklists`). `onFiltersChange(next)` → `setFilters(next); setLaterLimit(20)`. `onClearFilters()` → `setFilters({ search: "", energy: "all", priority: "any", sort: "due" }); setLaterLimit(20)`. `onOpen({ taskId })` → `router.replace("/tasks?task=" + encodeURIComponent(taskId), { scroll: false })` (TFV2-0129b reads `?task=`). `onLoadMore()` → `setLaterLimit((n) => n + 20)`. `onUndo()` → `const u = undoRef.current; undoRef.current = null; setToast(null); if (u) await u();`. `onDismissToast()` → `undoRef.current = null; setToast(null)`. `onRetry` is supplied by `TasksBoundary`; inside `TasksLive` it is a no-op. The View calls each handler and ignores its promise; a failed Undo shows the UndoToast's own error line (`gx.toast.undoError`), and a failed Quick add / tick / step tick leaves the list unchanged (the reactive query still shows the true rows) with no new copy, because the v3 design has none for it (the builder lists this under REPORT `notes for ticket sync`).
  - Render: `<TasksView state={state} data={{ groups, shownCount, laterShown, laterTotal, filters, quickAddBusy: busy, toast }} online={online} …handlers />`.
  States: as TFV2-0128a (`default`, `empty`, `filtered-empty`, `loading`, `error`) plus forced `offline`. Copy: none of its own (all in TasksView). RTL / keyboard / breakpoints / motion: from TasksView. Route wrapper: the page adds no wrapper element; no existing spec asserts a `/tasks` wrapper test id.

  ```ts
  // apps/web/components/tasks/TaskSheetView.tsx ("use client")
  export type TaskSheetLevel = "low" | "medium" | "high";   // convex/tasks.ts energy values
  export type TaskSheetState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";  // "empty" = new task, blank fields
  export type TaskSheetTask = {
    title: string;
    date: string;               // "YYYY-MM-DD" or "" (no day)
    time: string;               // "HH:MM" 24-hour or "" (no time)
    minutes: number | null;     // planned length; null = not set
    kind: "fixed" | "flex";
    energy: TaskSheetLevel;
    notes: string;
  };
  export type TaskSheetNag = { on: boolean; phrase: string };
  export type TaskSheetData = {
    taskId: string | null;      // null in state "empty"
    task: TaskSheetTask;        // initial field values; the form resets when taskId changes
    nag: TaskSheetNag | null;   // null → the nag section is not rendered
    saving: boolean;            // true → Save disabled + aria-busy, Delete disabled
  };
  export type TaskSheetValues = TaskSheetTask & { nag: TaskSheetNag | null };
  export type TaskSheetViewProps = {
    state: TaskSheetState;
    data: TaskSheetData;
    online: boolean;            // false → StateOffline at the top of the body; the form stays usable
    onSave: (args: { taskId: string | null; values: TaskSheetValues }) => void; // values trimmed (title, notes, phrase)
    onDelete: (args: { taskId: string }) => void;
    onClose: () => void;        // Close button, Cancel, Esc, scrim click
    onRetry: () => void;
  };

"" : String(v.minutes)} options={lengthOptions} onChange=… />`; `<RadioGroup legend={copy.kind}><Radio id={fixedId} name={kindName} value="fixed" label={copy.fixed} hint={copy.fixedHint} checked={v.kind === "fixed"} onChange=… /><Radio id={flexId} name={kindName} value="flex" label={copy.flex} hint={copy.flexHint} checked={v.kind === "flex"} onChange=… /></RadioGroup>`; `<Segmented label={copy.energy} block options={[{ value: "low", label: copy.energyLow }, { value: "medium", label: copy.energyMedium }, { value: "high", label: copy.energyHigh }]} value={v.energy} onChange=… />`; when `data.nag !== null`: `<Switch id={nagId} label={copy.nag} help={copy.nagHelp} checked={v.nag.on} onChange=… />` and, only while `v.nag.on`, `<TextInput id={phraseId} label={copy.phrase} help={copy.phraseHelp} value={v.nag.phrase} onChange=… error={phraseError ? copy.phraseErr : undefined} />`; `<Textarea id={notesId} label={copy.notes} rows={3} value={v.notes} onChange=… />`. `lengthOptions` = `[{ value: "", label: copy.lenNone }, …[10, 15, 25, 45].map((n) => ({ value: String(n), label: copy.lenMin.replace("{n}", String(n)) })), { value: "60", label: copy.lenHour }]`, plus `{ value: String(m), label: copy.lenMin.replace("{n}", String(m)) }` inserted in numeric order when the task's own `minutes` (m) is not one of 10/15/25/45/60.

  Behaviour: the form values `v` are local state seeded from `data.task` and `data.nag` (re-seeded when `data.taskId` changes). Submit: `title = v.title.trim()`; empty → `nameError = true`, focus the name input, no callback; `v.nag?.on && !v.nag.phrase.trim()` → `phraseError = true`, focus the phrase input, no callback; else `onSave({ taskId: data.taskId, values: { ...v, title, notes: v.notes.trim(), nag: v.nag && { on: v.nag.on, phrase: v.nag.phrase.trim() } } })`. Editing a field clears its error. Switching the nag off hides the phrase field and clears `phraseError`. Focus: on mount the name input is focused (`loading`/`error`: the Close button); `trap` keeps Tab inside the section (Tab on the last focusable → first; Shift+Tab on the first → last; focusables = enabled `button, input, select, textarea, [href]` inside the section); Esc anywhere in the section calls `onClose`; on unmount focus returns to the element that was focused when the sheet mounted (`useEffect` stores `document.activeElement`).

  // apps/web/components/journal/JournalView.tsx ("use client")
  export type JournalState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";
  export type JournalEntry = {
    id: string;          // notes row id; link target /notes/<id>
    date: string;        // "YYYY-MM-DD"
    title: string;       // page title; "" → the formatted date is the title
    tags: string[];      // page-meta tags (≤ 12), user text
  };
  export type JournalData = {
    today: string;       // "YYYY-MM-DD" in the person's time zone
    prompt: string;      // today's prompt, already localised (one of the repo's journal.p.1 … journal.p.7)
    entries: JournalEntry[];  // past days only, newest first
    hasMore: boolean;    // true → "Show more" button
    loadingMore: boolean;
  };
  export type JournalViewProps = {
    state: JournalState;
    data: JournalData;
    online: boolean;     // false → StateOffline under the head; links and buttons stay usable
    onAnotherPrompt: () => void;
    onLoadMore: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function JournalView(props: JournalViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```
  Layout inside `<div className="tp-page" data-component="JournalView">`:
  1. `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader"><div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title">{copy.title}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{copy.sub}</p></div></header>` (all states).
  2. `{!online && <StateOffline />}` (all states).
  3. Prompt surface (states `default` and `empty`): `<section className="tp-surface" data-component="Surface" aria-labelledby={promptHeadId}><span className="tp-eyebrow" id={promptHeadId}>{copy.prompt}</span><p className="tp-muted tp-small"><time dateTime={data.today}>{journalDate(data.today, lang)}</time></p><h2 className="tp-section__title" dir="auto">{data.prompt}</h2><p className="tp-muted tp-small">{copy.optional}</p><div className="tp-form__actions"><a className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" href="/today"><TpIcon name="edit" size="sm" /><span>{copy.write}</span></a><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={onAnotherPrompt}><TpIcon name="refresh" size="sm" /><span>{copy.another}</span></button></div></section>`.
  4. Body: `default` → `<section className="tp-section" data-component="Section" aria-labelledby={pastId}><div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id={pastId}>{copy.past}</h2></div><List label={copy.past}>{entries.map((e) => <ListRow key={e.id} title={e.title || journalDate(e.date, lang)} icon={<TpIcon name="today" size="sm" />} meta={<><time dateTime={e.date}>{journalDate(e.date, lang)}</time>{e.tags.map((tag) => <span className="tp-tag" key={tag} dir="auto">{tag}</span>)}</>} end={<TpIcon name="chevron" size="sm" flip />} href={"/notes/" + e.id} />)}</List>{data.hasMore && <div><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" disabled={data.loadingMore} aria-busy={data.loadingMore || undefined} onClick={onLoadMore}><TpIcon name="down" size="sm" /><span>{copy.more}</span></button></div>}</section>`; `empty` → `<StateEmpty title={copy.emptyTitle} body={copy.emptyBody} icon={<TpIcon name="edit" size="lg" />} action={<a className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" href="/today"><TpIcon name="edit" size="sm" /><span>{copy.emptyAction}</span></a>} />`; `loading` → `<StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={4} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={copy.error} onRetry={onRetry} />`.
  Copy (`COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>>`):

  | key | EN | HE |
  |---|---|---|
  | title | Journal (repo `journal.title`) | יומן |
  | sub | Your daily pages, newest first. Write as much or as little as you like. (repo `journal.sub`) | הדפים היומיים שלך, מהחדש לישן. אפשר לכתוב הרבה או מעט. |
  | prompt | Today's prompt (repo `journal.prompt`) | השאלה של היום |
  | optional | Optional. Writing anything else is fine. (repo `journal.optional`) | לא חובה. אפשר לכתוב כל דבר אחר. |
  | write | Write in today's page (repo `journal.write`) | לכתוב בדף של היום |
  | another | Another prompt (repo `journal.another`) | שאלה אחרת |
  | past | Past days (repo `journal.past`) | ימים קודמים |
  | more | Show more (repo `journal.more`) | להציג עוד |
  | emptyTitle | Your journal is ready when you are. | היומן כאן כשמתאים לך. |
  | emptyBody | Write one line about today, or answer the prompt. There's no right length. | אפשר לכתוב שורה אחת על היום, או לענות על השאלה. אין אורך נכון. |
  | emptyAction | Write a line | לכתוב שורה |
  | loading | Loading your pages… (repo `journal.loading`) | טוענים את הדפים… |
  | error | Couldn't load your journal. | לא הצלחנו לטעון את היומן. |

  The design's Hebrew empty title uses a gendered verb and is replaced by the neutral line above (CONVENTIONS §12). Dates come from the repo's `journalDate` ("Monday, 12 October 2026" / "יום שני, 12 באוקטובר 2026"). StateError adds "Your data is safe." / "המידע שלך שמור." and "Try again" / "לנסות שוב"; StateOffline uses its default text.
  States: `default`, `empty`, `loading`, `error`; offline = `online: false`. Harness sections (order → props): `default` (state default, today `"2026-10-12"`, prompt `"What is one thing that went better than you expected?"` (the same string in both languages: the prompt is a localised prop, and §13 lets the harness import nothing but React, the View and its types), entries `[{ id: "n1", date: "2026-10-11", title: "", tags: ["move"] }, { id: "n2", date: "2026-10-09", title: "Quiet Friday", tags: [] }]`, hasMore true, loadingMore false, online true); `empty` (state empty, entries [], hasMore false); `loading-more` (the `default` props with `loadingMore: true`); `loading`; `error` (both with the `empty` data); `offline` (the `default` props with `online: false`).
  RTL: logical classes; ListRow chevron is flipped (`flip`) so it points to the inline end; dates and tags keep `dir="auto"` / `<time>`. Keyboard: links and buttons in DOM order (Write → Another prompt → each day row → Show more). Screen reader: one `h1`; the prompt surface is labelled by its eyebrow; the list is labelled "Past days"; StateLoading is `role="status"`. Breakpoints: 390 base (actions wrap), 768/1024/1280 (`.tp-page` max width, same single column). Motion: Stage 1 hover transitions only.
  Compat selectors: no CI spec opens `/journal`; the storage-state smoke `tests/e2e/feature-sweep.spec.ts:1148` only checks the route is not signed out, not 404 and not a scaffold — kept.

(Fixture prompts are English in both languages; the live page localises.)

  Page (`apps/web/app/(tempo)/journal/page.tsx`, `"use client"`):
  - `const NOOP = { onAnotherPrompt: () => {}, onLoadMore: () => {}, onRetry: () => {} };` `export default function Page() { return <Suspense fallback={null}><JournalPage /></Suspense>; }`.
  - `JournalPage`: `const forced = useE2EState(); const online = useOnline();` forced → `const fx = forced in FIXTURES ? FIXTURES[forced as keyof typeof FIXTURES] : FIXTURES.error; return <JournalView {...fx} online={forced === "offline" ? false : online && fx.online} {...NOOP} />;` (display-only; no Convex hook runs in this branch). Else `return <ProfileReady fallback={<JournalView {...FIXTURES.loading} online={online} {...NOOP} />}><JournalBoundary online={online}><JournalLive online={online} /></JournalBoundary></ProfileReady>;` (under the signed-out dev bypass `ProfileReady` renders its children, whose queries never resolve against the placeholder URL, so the loading state shows).
  - `JournalBoundary`: `class JournalBoundary extends Component<{ online: boolean; children: ReactNode }, { failed: boolean; attempt: number }>`: `state = { failed: false, attempt: 0 }`; `static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { failed: true }; }`; `render()` → when `failed`: `<JournalView {...FIXTURES.error} online={this.props.online} {...NOOP} onRetry={() => this.setState((s) => ({ failed: false, attempt: s.attempt + 1 }))} />`; else `<Fragment key={this.state.attempt}>{this.props.children}</Fragment>` (a new key remounts the data component, which re-subscribes its queries).
  - `ChunkQuery({ before, onRows })` (renders `null`): `const rows = useQuery(api.notes.listPeriodPages, { pageType: "daily", before, limit: 10 }); useEffect(() => onRows(before, rows), [before, rows, onRows]); return null;` with `rows: FunctionReturnType<typeof api.notes.listPeriodPages> | undefined` (`FunctionReturnType` from `convex/server`).
  - `JournalLive({ online })`: `const { t } = useLocale(); const prefs = useQuery(api.preferences.get, {}); const today = prefs ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: prefs.timeZone, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).format(Date.now()) : null; const [cursors, setCursors] = useState<string[]>([]); const [chunks, setChunks] = useState<Record<string, PeriodPageRow[] | undefined>>({}); const [picked, setPicked] = useState<{ day: string | null; shift: number }>({ day: null, shift: 0 });` When `today` changes, `setCursors([today]); setChunks({})` (a new day starts the list again). `onRows = useCallback((before, rows) => setChunks((c) => (c[before] === rows ? c : { ...c, [before]: rows })), [])`. Render every cursor as `<ChunkQuery key={c} before={c} onRows={onRows} />` next to the View. Derived: `entries` = cursors in order, each defined chunk's rows mapped `{ id: r._id, date: r.date, title: r.title, tags: r.tags }` (stop at the first undefined chunk); `last = chunks[cursors[cursors.length - 1]]`; `hasMore = last !== undefined && last.length === 10`; `loadingMore = cursors.length > 1 && last === undefined`; `shift = picked.day === today ? picked.shift : 0`; `prompt = today ? t(promptFor(today, shift)) : ""` (`promptFor` from `@/lib/journal`). `state`: `prefs === undefined || today === null || chunks[today] === undefined` → `"loading"`; `chunks[today].length === 0` → `"empty"`; else `"default"`. Handlers: `onAnotherPrompt` → `setPicked({ day: today, shift: shift + 1 })`; `onLoadMore` → append the last entry's `date` to `cursors` when `hasMore && !loadingMore`; `onRetry` → no-op inside `JournalLive` (the boundary supplies the real one).
  - Render: `<><JournalView state={state} data={{ today: today ?? "", prompt, entries, hasMore, loadingMore }} online={online} onAnotherPrompt=… onLoadMore=… onRetry={() => {}} />{cursors.map(…ChunkQuery…)}</>`.
  Wiring line (CONVENTIONS §17), exactly: `  "/journal",` inserted as the last entry before `] as const;` (on `integration` today that is right after `  "/onboarding",`).
  States: `default`, `empty`, `loading`, `error`, plus forced `offline`. Copy: none of its own (JournalView owns all strings). Route wrapper: none (no spec asserts one).
  Compat: storage-state smoke `tests/e2e/feature-sweep.spec.ts:1148` (`/journal` signed in, not a scaffold) — kept.

  ```ts
  // apps/web/components/calendar/AddEventSheet.tsx ("use client")
  export type AddEventValues = {
    title: string;              // trimmed, non-empty
    date: string;               // "YYYY-MM-DD"
    start: string;              // "HH:MM" 24-hour
    end: string;                // "HH:MM", later than start on the same day
    kind: "fixed" | "flex";
    place: string;              // trimmed; "" = none
  };
  export type AddEventSheetProps = {
    initialDate: string;        // "YYYY-MM-DD" preset for the Day field

  };
  export function AddEventSheet(props: AddEventSheetProps): JSX.Element;
  ```
  Markup (fragment root): `<div className="tp-sheet-scrim" aria-hidden="true" onClick={onClose} />` and `<section className="tp-sheet tp-glass" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={titleId} data-component="MobileSheet" data-view="AddEventSheet" onKeyDown={trap}>` → `<span className="tp-sheet__grabber" aria-hidden="true" />`; `<div className="tp-sheet__head"><h2 className="tp-sheet__title" id={titleId}>{copy.title}</h2><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--icon" aria-label={copy.close} onClick={onClose}><TpIcon name="x" /></button></div>`; `<div className="tp-sheet__body">{!online && <StateOffline />}<form className="tp-form" data-component="Form" id={formId} noValidate onSubmit={submit}>` with, in order: `<TextInput id={nameId} label={copy.name} placeholder={copy.namePh} value={v.title} onChange=… error={nameError ? copy.nameErr : undefined} autoComplete="off" />`; a `.tp-field` with `<label className="tp-label" htmlFor={dateId}>{copy.date}</label><input className="tp-input tp-num" id={dateId} type="date" dir="ltr" value={v.date} …/>`; `<div className="tp-toolbar">` with two `.tp-field`s: start (`<label htmlFor={startId}>{copy.start}</label><input className="tp-input tp-num" id={startId} type="time" step={300} dir="ltr" …/>`) and end (`copy.end`, same input with `aria-invalid={endError || undefined}` and `aria-describedby={endError ? endErrId : undefined}`, then `{endError && <p className="tp-error-text" id={endErrId} role="alert">{copy.endErr}</p>}`); `<RadioGroup legend={copy.kind}><Radio id={fixedId} name={kindName} value="fixed" label={copy.fixed} hint={copy.fixedHint} checked={v.kind === "fixed"} onChange=… /><Radio id={flexId} name={kindName} value="flex" label={copy.flex} hint={copy.flexHint} checked={v.kind === "flex"} onChange=… /></RadioGroup>`; `<TextInput id={placeId} label={copy.place} optional value={v.place} onChange=… autoComplete="off" />`. Foot `<div className="tp-sheet__foot"><button type="submit" form={formId} className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" disabled={saving} aria-busy={saving || undefined}><TpIcon name="check" size="sm" /><span>{copy.save}</span></button><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" onClick={onClose}>{copy.cancel}</button></div>`.
  Behaviour: local form state `v` starts `{ title: "", date: initialDate, start: "10:00", end: "11:00", kind: "fixed", place: "" }` (the design's defaults). Submit: `title = v.title.trim()`; empty → `nameError`, focus name, no callback; `v.end <= v.start` (string compare of "HH:MM") → `endError`, focus end, no callback; else `onSave({ ...v, title, place: v.place.trim() })`. Editing a field clears its error. Focus: name input on mount; Tab / Shift+Tab wrap inside the section; Esc calls `onClose`; on unmount focus returns to the element focused at mount.
  Copy (`COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>>`):

  | key | EN | HE |
  |---|---|---|
  | title | Add event | הוספת אירוע |
  | close | Close | סגירה |
  | name | What is it? | מה זה? |
  | namePh | Coffee with Dana | קפה עם דנה |
  | nameErr | Give it a short name, so you'll know it later. | כדאי לתת שם קצר, כדי שיהיה קל לזהות אותו אחר כך. |
  | date | Day | יום |
  | start | Starts | מתחיל |
  | end | Ends | נגמר |
  | endErr | The end time needs to be after the start time. | שעת הסיום צריכה להיות אחרי שעת ההתחלה. |
  | kind | How firm is it? | כמה זה קבוע? |
  | fixed | Fixed | קבוע |
  | fixedHint | Happens at this time. Tempo plans around it. | קורה בשעה הזאת. Tempo מתכנן סביב זה. |
  | flex | Flexible | גמיש |
  | flexHint | A good time for it. It can move if the day changes. | שעה טובה לזה. אפשר להזיז אם היום משתנה. |
  | place | Where | איפה |
  | save | Save event | שמירת האירוע |
  | cancel | Cancel | ביטול |

  The design's Hebrew name error uses a gendered verb and is replaced by the neutral line above (CONVENTIONS §12). TextInput's `optional` marker text comes from TFV2-0113; StateOffline uses its default text.
  States (harness order → props): `default` (`initialDate: "2026-10-12"`, saving false, online true), `saving` (saving true), `offline` (online false). Field-error states are reached by interaction (TESTS).
  RTL: logical properties; Close at the inline end (left in Hebrew); date/time inputs `dir="ltr"`. Keyboard / screen reader: `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal`, named by its heading; errors are `role="alert"` and linked by `aria-describedby`. Breakpoints: bottom sheet at 390, centred panel from 768 (tempo.css); 1024/1280 as 768. Motion: tempo.css `tp-rise` (240 ms) and `tp-fade`; none under reduced motion.
  Compat: the CI specs on `/calendar` fill `Event title` and `Event date` in an always-visible inline form (`tests/e2e/calendar-views.spec.ts:20-22`, `tests/e2e/fix/calendar-add.spec.ts:31-34`); this sheet's fields are `What is it?` / `Day` and appear only after `Add event` — conflict (R3-Q1; TFV2-0131b keeps those specs green through the old signed-out branch).

  ```ts
  // apps/web/components/calendar/CalendarView.tsx ("use client")
  import type { MonthGridDay } from "@/components/calendar/MonthGrid";
  import type { EventBlockItem } from "@/components/blocks/EventBlock";
  import type { AddEventValues } from "@/components/calendar/AddEventSheet";
  export type CalendarState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";   // "empty" = no events in the shown month
  export type CalendarData = {
    month: string;               // "YYYY-MM" shown in the grid
    weekStartsOn: 0 | 1 | 6;     // from userPreferences.weekStartsOn
    days: MonthGridDay[];        // full weeks covering the month, ordered by weekStartsOn
    today: string;               // "YYYY-MM-DD" in the person's time zone
    selected: string;            // "YYYY-MM-DD"
    dayEvents: EventBlockItem[]; // events of `selected`, by start time
    timeZone: string;            // IANA, from userPreferences.timeZone (passed to EventBlock)
    sheet: { open: boolean; saving: boolean };
    toast: { id: number; undoUntilMs: number } | null;
  };
  export type CalendarViewProps = {
    state: CalendarState;
    data: CalendarData;
    online: boolean;             // false → StateOffline under the head; everything stays usable
    onSelectDay: (date: string) => void;
    onPrevMonth: () => void;
    onNextMonth: () => void;
    onOpenAdd: () => void;
    onCloseAdd: () => void;
    onAddEvent: (values: AddEventValues) => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
    onUndo: () => void;
    onDismissToast: () => void;
  };
  export function CalendarView(props: CalendarViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```

"he-IL" : "en-GB", { month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(Date.parse(data.month + "-01T00:00:00Z"))`; `dayTitle` = the same formatter with `{ weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", timeZone: "UTC" }` on `data.selected`.

"UTC"; const today = isoInZone(Date.now(), tz); const [month, setMonth] = useState<string | null>(null); const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);` — when `prefs` first arrives and `month === null`: `setMonth(today.slice(0, 7)); setSelected(today)`. `const first = (month ?? today.slice(0, 7)) + "-01"; const nextFirst = addDays(first, 32).slice(0, 7) + "-01";` Range `{ startMs: zonedMs(first, "00:00", tz), endMs: zonedMs(nextFirst, "00:00", tz) }` (one calendar month ≤ 31 days + 1 h, inside the 32-day cap). `const events = useQuery(api.calendar_events.listInRange, prefs && month ? range : "skip");` Mutations `create = useMutation(api.calendar_events.create)`, `remove = useMutation(api.calendar_events.remove)`; local state `const [sheetOpen, setSheetOpen] = useState(false); const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false); const [toast, setToast] = useState<CalendarData["toast"]>(null); const undoRef = useRef<(() => Promise<unknown>) | null>(null);` (`CalendarData` is exported by `CalendarView`).
  - Derived: grid `days` = from `gridStart = addDays(first, -((dow(first) - prefs.weekStartsOn + 7) % 7))` to `gridEnd = addDays(lastOfMonth, (prefs.weekStartsOn + 6 - dow(lastOfMonth)) % 7)` inclusive, where `dow(iso) = new Date(iso + "T00:00:00Z").getUTCDay()` and `lastOfMonth = addDays(nextFirst, -1)`; each `{ date, n: Number(date.slice(8)), outside: date.slice(0, 7) !== month, today: date === today, dots }` with `dots` = one entry per event whose `isoInZone(startsAtMs, tz) === date`, in start order, each `"done"` when `(endsAtMs ?? startsAtMs) < Date.now()` else `"fixed"` (every stored event is a fixed-time item until R3-Q3 is answered). `dayEvents` = events with `isoInZone(startsAtMs, tz) === selected`, sorted by `startsAtMs`, mapped `{ id: e._id, title: e.title, startsAtMs: e.startsAtMs, endsAtMs: e.endsAtMs, kind: "fixed" }`. `state`: `prefs === undefined || month === null || events === undefined` → `"loading"`; `events.length === 0` → `"empty"`; else `"default"`.
  - Handlers: `onSelectDay(date)` → `setSelected(date)`; when `date.slice(0, 7) !== month`, also `setMonth(date.slice(0, 7))`. `onPrevMonth` → `m = addDays(first, -1).slice(0, 7)`; `onNextMonth` → `m = nextFirst.slice(0, 7)`; both then `setMonth(m); setSelected(today.slice(0, 7) === m ? today : m + "-01")`. `onOpenAdd` → `setSheetOpen(true)`; `onCloseAdd` → `setSheetOpen(false)`. `onAddEvent(v)` → `setSaving(true); try { const eventId = await create({ title: v.title, startsAtMs: zonedMs(v.date, v.start, tz), endsAtMs: zonedMs(v.date, v.end, tz) }); undoRef.current = () => remove({ eventId }); setToast({ id: Date.now(), undoUntilMs: Date.now() + 300_000 }); setSheetOpen(false); setSelected(v.date); setMonth(v.date.slice(0, 7)); } finally { setSaving(false); }` (`v.kind` and `v.place` are not stored: no field exists — R3-Q3). `onUndo()` → `const u = undoRef.current; undoRef.current = null; setToast(null); if (u) await u();`. `onDismissToast()` → `undoRef.current = null; setToast(null)`. `onRetry` is supplied by the boundary.
  - Render: `<CalendarView state={state} data={{ month: month ?? today.slice(0, 7), weekStartsOn: prefs?.weekStartsOn ?? 1, days, today, selected: selected ?? today, dayEvents, timeZone: tz, sheet: { open: sheetOpen, saving }, toast }} online={online} …handlers />`.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  import type { ReactNode } from "react";
  export type HabitsState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";
  export type HabitsCadence = "daily" | "weekly";
  export type HabitsDay = { localDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */; weekday: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 /* 0 = Sunday */; day: number /* 1–31 */; isToday: boolean };
  export type HabitsItem = { id: string; name: string; cadence: HabitsCadence; loggedDates: string[] /* YYYY-MM-DD within days, today excluded */; loggedToday: boolean };
  export type HabitsToast = { habitId: string; undoUntilMs: number };
  export type HabitsData = {
    todayKey: string;          // YYYY-MM-DD, the person's local day
    days: HabitsDay[];         // exactly 7, oldest first, last one isToday
    habits: HabitsItem[];      // newest first; empty in "empty" | "loading" | "error"
    saveError: boolean;        // a check-in, create or undo failed
    toasts: HabitsToast[];     // one per habit added in the last 5 minutes
  };
  export type HabitsDraft = { name: string; cadence: HabitsCadence };
  export type HabitsViewProps = {
    state: HabitsState;
    data: HabitsData;
    online: boolean;
    suggestions?: ReactNode;   // rendered only in "default", after the quick-add form
    onToggleToday: (habitId: string) => void;
    onCreate: (draft: HabitsDraft) => Promise<void>; // rejects when the save failed
    onUndoCreate: (habitId: string) => Promise<void>;
    onCloseToast: (habitId: string) => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function HabitsView(props: HabitsViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```
  **Layout** (390 px base, classes exactly as listed; no inline styles): root `<div className="tp-page" data-component="PageLayout" data-view="HabitsView">`. 1) Header `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader">` → `<div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title">{title}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{sub}</p></div>` and, only in `default`, `<div className="tp-pagehead__actions">{newButton}</div>`. `newButton` = `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" data-component="Button" aria-controls="new-habit" aria-expanded={sheetOpen}>` with `<TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" />` + `<span>{newHabit}</span>`; click opens the sheet. 2) `online === false` → `<StateOffline />` (default text) directly under the header in every state. 3) `data.saveError` → `<Notice tone="caution" title={saveError} live="alert" />`. 4) State body: `loading` → `<StateLoading label={loading} rows={4} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={error} onRetry={onRetry} />`; `empty` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="habit" size="lg" />} title={emptyTitle} body={emptyBody} action={newButton} />` then the quick-add form; `default` → `<section className="tp-section" data-component="Section" aria-labelledby="hb-today">` with `<div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id="hb-today"><span>{today}</span> · <span>{longDate(todayKey)}</span></h2><span className="tp-section__count"><span className="tp-num">{loggedCount}</span> <span>{of}</span> <span className="tp-num">{habits.length}</span> <span>{loggedTodayWord}</span></span></div>`, `<p className="tp-muted tp-small">{localDay with {day} = weekday-long name of todayKey}</p>`, `<div className="hb-list">` with one card per habit, then the quick-add form, then `{suggestions}`. 5) Card: `<article className="tp-surface tp-block-habit hb-card" data-component="HabitBlock">` → `<div className="tp-habit" data-habit={id} data-logged={String(loggedToday)}>` → head `<div className="tp-habit__head">` with `<a className="tp-habit__name" id={\`hb-${id}-name\`} href={\`/habits/${id}\`} dir="auto">{name}</a>`, `<span className="tp-habit__when">{cadence === "weekly" ? rhythmWeekly : rhythmDaily}</span>`, and `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary tp-habit__log" aria-pressed={loggedToday} aria-describedby={\`hb-${id}-name\`} aria-label={label + (loggedToday ? unlogSr : logSr).replace("{name}", name)}>` (`label` = `logged` or `log`) holding `<TpIcon name="check" size="sm" />` + `<span>{label}</span>`; click → `onToggleToday(id)`. Then `<ol className="tp-habit-days" aria-label={last7}>` with 7 `<li className="tp-habit-day" data-done={String(done)} data-today={isToday ? "true" : undefined}>` each holding `<span className="tp-habit-day__dot" aria-hidden="true"><TpIcon name="check" /></span>`, `<span className="tp-habit-day__label"><span>{dow[weekday]}</span> <span className="tp-num">{day}</span></span>`, `<span className="tp-sr-only">{done ? dayDone : dayOpen}</span>`, where `done` = `isToday ? loggedToday : loggedDates.includes(localDate)`. Then `<p className="tp-habit__summary">` rendering `summary` with `{n}` = count of done days and `{total}` = `7`, each number in `<span className="tp-num">`. 6) Quick-add form (in `default` and `empty`): `<form className="tp-toolbar" data-component="Toolbar" noValidate>` → `<div className="tp-field tp-toolbar__grow"><label className="tp-sr-only" htmlFor="habits-library-name">{quickLabel}</label><input className="tp-input" id="habits-library-name" type="text" dir="auto" autoComplete="off" maxLength={HABIT_NAME_MAX} placeholder={placeholder} aria-invalid={invalid || undefined} aria-describedby={invalid ? "hb-quick-error" : undefined} />{invalid ? <p className="tp-error-text" id="hb-quick-error">{quickError}</p> : null}</div>` and `<button className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" type="submit" disabled={busy}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{quickAdd}</span></button>`. 7) Sheet: when open, `<HabitSheet id="new-habit" title={newHabit} initial={{ name: "", cadence: "daily" }} onSubmit={onCreate} onClose={() => setSheetOpen(false)} />`. 8) Toasts: when `data.toasts.length > 0`, `<div className="tp-toast-region">` with one `<UndoToast key={habitId} title={added} undoUntilMs={undoUntilMs} onUndo={() => onUndoCreate(habitId)} onClose={() => onCloseToast(habitId)} />` each. Tokens come only from tempo.css/habits.css classes: `.hb-list` gap `--tp-space-4`, `.hb-card` gap `--tp-space-3`, dot `calc(var(--tp-space-6) + var(--tp-space-1))` = 28 px with `--tp-line-control` ring and `--tp-done` fill.
  **Behaviour:** `longDate(key)` = `Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", timeZone: "UTC" })`; `locale` = `"he-IL"` for `he`, else `"en-GB"`. Quick add submit: `preventDefault()`; if a submit is already running (a `useRef(false)` flag set before the first `await`) do nothing; trimmed name empty → `invalid = true`, focus the input, no callback; else `invalid = false`, `busy = true`, `await onCreate({ name, cadence: "daily" })`; on success clear the input; on rejection keep the text (the route shows `saveError`); finally `busy = false` and clear the flag. Typing clears `invalid` once the trimmed value is not empty. `loggedCount` = habits with `loggedToday`.
  **States** (harness order; route fixture names match): `default` (two habits), `empty`, `loading`, `error`, `offline` (`state: "default"`, `online: false`), `save-error` (`state: "default"`, `data.saveError: true`), `toast` (`state: "default"`, one toast). There is no disabled state; offline keeps every control enabled (changes queue in Convex). Welcome-back/Start fresh/Pause from the design are out of scope (no backend; the builder lists this under REPORT `notes for ticket sync`).

  export type HabitDetailState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error" | "not-found";

  export type HabitDetailSummary = { logged: number; total: number; easiestWeekday: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | null; todayLogged: boolean };

    summary: HabitDetailSummary;
    saveError: boolean;
  };
  export type HabitDetailDraft = { name: string; cadence: HabitDetailCadence };
  export type HabitDetailViewProps = {
    state: HabitDetailState;

    online: boolean;

  function buildWeeks(todayKey: string, weekStartsOn: 0 | 1 | 6, logged: ReadonlySet<string>): HabitDetailWeek[] {
    const offset = ((parseLocalDate(todayKey)?.getDay() ?? 0) - weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
    const gridStart = addLocalDays(addLocalDays(todayKey, -offset), -35);
    return [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((w) => {
      const cells = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((d) => {
        const key = addLocalDays(gridStart, w * 7 + d);
        return { localDate: key, day: Number(key.slice(8)), checked: logged.has(key), isFuture: key > todayKey, isToday: key === todayKey };
      });
      return { startDate: cells[0].localDate, cells };
    });
  }
  ```

  export type RoutinesState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";
  export type RoutineCardData = {
    id: string;                // the notes id of the #routine page
    title: string;             // trimmed page title; "" shows the Untitled word
    stepCount: number;         // 0 … n
    firstSteps: string[];      // the first ≤ 3 step titles
    minutes: number | null;    // sum of known step minutes, null when none known
    usualTime: string | null;  // "HH:MM" after the tag, or null
  };
  export type RoutinesData = { routines: RoutineCardData[]; fitsNowId: string | null; creating: boolean; saveError: boolean };
  export type RoutinesViewProps = {
    state: RoutinesState;
    data: RoutinesData;
    online: boolean;
    onNewRoutine: (title: string) => void; // title = COPY.newRoutine in the current language
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function RoutinesView(props: RoutinesViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export type RoutineDetailState = "default" | "paused" | "finished" | "empty" | "loading" | "error" | "not-found";
  export type RoutineStepStatus = "done" | "now" | "skipped" | "next";
  export type RoutineDetailStep = { title: string; note: string | null; minutes: number | null };
  export type RoutineDetailRun = { index: number /* current step; === steps.length when finished */; statuses: RoutineStepStatus[]; paused: boolean };
  export type RoutineDetailData = {
    routine: { id: string; title: string /* "" → Untitled */; steps: RoutineDetailStep[]; minutes: number | null } | null; // null in loading | error | not-found
    run: RoutineDetailRun;      // statuses.length === steps.length
    resumed: boolean;           // the route picked up a saved place on open
  };
  export type RoutineDetailViewProps = {
    state: RoutineDetailState;
    data: RoutineDetailData;
    online: boolean;
    onDone: () => void;
    onSkip: () => void;
    onTogglePause: () => void;
    onBack: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function RoutineDetailView(props: RoutineDetailViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```

  export type GoalsViewProps = {

    data: GoalsData;

    onCreate: (title: string) => Promise<string>; // resolves the new goal id; rejects when the save failed

    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function GoalsView(props: GoalsViewProps): JSX.Element;

  ```ts
  export const WHY_SAVE_DELAY_MS = 800;
  export type GoalDetailState = "default" | "loading" | "error" | "not-found";
  export type GoalDetailStatus = "active" | "resting" | "done";   // stored active | archived | completed
  export type GoalDetailData = {
    goal: { id: string; title: string; why: string | null; status: GoalDetailStatus } | null; // null in loading | error | not-found
    saveError: boolean;
  };
  export type GoalDetailViewProps = {
    state: GoalDetailState;
    data: GoalDetailData;
    online: boolean;
    onSaveTitle: (title: string) => void;            // trimmed, non-empty, different from data
    onSaveWhy: (why: string | null) => Promise<void>; // null clears it; rejects when the save failed
    onSetStatus: (status: GoalDetailStatus) => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function GoalDetailView(props: GoalDetailViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```
  **Layout:** root `<div className="tp-page gd-stack" data-component="PageLayout" data-view="GoalDetailView">`, first child the back link `<Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--sm" href="/goals"><TpIcon name="chevron" size="sm" className="tp-icon--back" /><span>{back}</span></Link>`. `loading` → `<StateLoading label={loading} rows={2} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={error} onRetry={onRetry} />`; `not-found` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="flag" size="lg" />} title={gone} action={<Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" href="/goals"><span>{back}</span></Link>} />`. `default`: 1) `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader">` = `<div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title"><input className="gx-title-input" aria-label={titleLabel} dir="auto" value={title} /></h1><div className="tp-pagehead__sub gd-meta"><Badge label={statusWord} tone={TONE[status]} icon={<TpIcon name={ICON[status]} size="sm" />} /></div></div>` (`TONE = { active: "info", resting: "neutral", done: "done" }`, `ICON = { active: "play", resting: "pause", done: "check" }`) and `<div className="tp-pagehead__actions gd-status"><Select id="gd-status" label={statusLabel} value={status} options={[{ value: "active", label: active }, { value: "resting", label: resting }, { value: "done", label: done }]} onChange={(v) => v !== status && onSetStatus(v as GoalDetailStatus)} /></div>`. 2) `online === false` → `<StateOffline />`. 3) `saveError` → `<Notice tone="caution" title={saveError} live="alert" />`. 4) `<div className="gd-stack">` = `<section className="tp-section gd-why" data-component="Section" aria-labelledby="why-h"><div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id="why-h">{whyHeading}</h2></div><div className="tp-surface" data-component="Surface"><textarea className="gd-why__input" aria-labelledby="why-h" dir="auto" spellCheck placeholder={whyDraft} value={why} /></div></section>` and `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="flag" size="lg" />} title={emptyTitle} body={emptyBody} />`. Tokens via goals.css (`.gd-stack` gap `--tp-space-6`) and the composed components.
  **Behaviour (title):** local `title`, initialised from `goal.title` and re-synced whenever `goal.title` changes while the input is not focused (a `useRef` focus flag). Enter blurs the input. On blur: `next = title.trim()`; empty → restore `goal.title`, no callback; `next !== goal.title` → `onSaveTitle(next)`. **Behaviour (why):** local `why` (initial `goal.why ?? ""`) and `savedWhy` ref (initial the same); both re-sync from `goal.why` while the textarea is not focused. Each change sets `why` and restarts a `window.setTimeout(WHY_SAVE_DELAY_MS)` that calls `saveWhy(value)`. `saveWhy(value)`: clear the timer; if `value === savedWhy.current` do nothing; else `onSaveWhy(value.trim() ? value : null).then(() => { savedWhy.current = value; })` (a rejection leaves `savedWhy` unchanged, so blur tries again). On blur: if `why !== savedWhy.current` call `saveWhy(why)`; else re-sync from `goal.why`. The timer is cleared on unmount. **Behaviour (status):** the Select change calls `onSetStatus` only when the value differs.
  **States** (harness order): `default`, `no-why` (`default` with `why: null`), `loading`, `error`, `not-found`, `offline` (`default` + `online: false`), `save-error` (`default` + `saveError: true`). Offline keeps every field editable.

    export type GoalsProgressState = "default" | "loading" | "empty" | "error" | "offline" | "signed-out";

  - **Page structure:**
    ```tsx
    export default function Page() { return <Suspense fallback={null}><GoalsProgressScreen /></Suspense>; }
    function GoalsProgressScreen() {
      const forced = useE2EState();
      const liveOnline = useOnline();
      if (forced !== null) {
        const key = (forced in FIXTURES ? forced : "loading") as GoalsProgressState;
        return <GoalsProgressBody view={FIXTURES[key]} online={key !== "offline"} onRetry={() => {}} />;
      }
      return <ScreenBoundary fallback={(retry) => <GoalsProgressBody view={{ status: "error" }} online={liveOnline} onRetry={retry} />}><GoalsProgressLive online={liveOnline} /></ScreenBoundary>;
    }

    `GoalsProgressLive` reads `useConvexAuth()`; `!isLoading && !isAuthenticated` → view `signed-out`; any query still `undefined` → `loading`; else the mapped view. `GoalsProgressBody({ view, online, onRetry }: { view: GoalsProgressView; online: boolean; onRetry: () => void })` renders the header in every state, then: `<div data-testid="goals-progress-offline"><StateOffline text={copy.offline} /></div>` when `online === false`, then exactly one state block: `loading` → `<div data-testid="goals-progress-loading"><StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={3} /></div>`; `error` → `<div data-testid="goals-progress-error"><StateError what={copy.error} onRetry={onRetry} /></div>`; `signed-out` → `<div data-testid="goals-progress-signed-out"><StateEmpty title={copy.signedOutTitle} action={<Link href="/sign-in" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" data-component="Button">{copy.signIn}</Link>} /></div>`; `empty` → `<div data-testid="goals-progress-empty"><StateEmpty title={copy.emptyTitle} body={copy.emptyBody} action={<Link href="/goals" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" data-component="Button">{copy.emptyAction}</Link>} /></div>`; `ready` → `<div data-testid="goals-progress-default">` holding three sections in this order:
    1. **By goal:** `<BarChart title={copy.barTitle} bars={…} summary={…} />` with one bar per goal: `label = title`, `value = done`, `pct = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round(done / total * 100)`. Summary = `copy.barSummary` with `{goals}` = goal count, `{done}` = sum of `done`, `{total}` = sum of `total`.
    2. **By week:** section head `<h2>` = `copy.lineTitle`; `<Segmented label={copy.rangeLabel} options={[{ value: "4", label: copy.range4 }, { value: "8", label: copy.range8 }]} value={range} onChange={setRange} />` (state `range: "4" | "8"`, initial `"8"`); then, for the selected goal (state `selectedGoalId`, initial = first goal with `status === "active"`, else the first goal): `weeks = view.weeksByGoal[selectedGoalId]`; `undefined` → `<StateLoading label={copy.loadingWeeks} rows={2} />`; else `<LineChart title={copy.lineChartTitle.replace("{goal}", goalTitle)} points={…} summary={…} />` with the last `Number(range)` weeks, `label` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang === "he" ? "he-IL" : "en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(new Date(\`${weekStart}T00:00:00Z\`))`, `value = doneCount`. Summary: zero weeks → `copy.lineSummaryNone`; else `copy.lineSummary` with `{min}`, `{max}` of `doneCount` and `{n}` = number of weeks shown.
    3. **In words:** `<List label={copy.listLabel}>` with one `<ListRow title={title} meta={copy.rowMeta…} end={<Badge label={statusWord} tone={…} />} onClick={() => setSelectedGoalId(goalId)} current={goalId === selectedGoalId} />` per goal. `meta` = `copy.rowMeta` with `{done}`/`{total}`. Badge: `active` → `copy.statusActive`, tone `"info"`; `completed` → `copy.statusDone`, tone `"done"`; `archived` → `copy.statusResting`, tone `"neutral"`.
    Numbers placed inside string props (`summary`, `meta`, `title`) are wrapped as `\u2066<n>\u2069` (LTR isolate, the string form of `.tp-num`, CONVENTIONS §12); numbers in JSX text use `<span className="tp-num">`.

    export type ProjectTaskRow = { id: string; title: string; status: "todo" | "in_progress" | "done" };
    export type ProjectDetailView =
      | { status: "loading" } | { status: "error" } | { status: "signed-out" }
      | { status: "ready"; projectId: string; name: string; projectStatus: "idea" | "active" | "paused" | "done"; tasks: ProjectTaskRow[]; added: string | null };

  - **Body:** offline block `project-detail-offline` (`StateOffline text={copy.offline}`); `loading` → `project-detail-loading` (`StateLoading label={copy.loading}`); `error` → `project-detail-error` (`StateError what={copy.error}`); `signed-out` → `project-detail-signed-out`; ready with no tasks → `<div data-testid="project-detail-empty"><StateEmpty title={copy.emptyTitle} body={copy.emptyBody} /></div>` followed by the add form with its submit label `copy.addFirst`; ready with tasks → `<div data-testid="project-detail-default">` holding: section "Open" — `<List label={copy.openList}>` rows for `todo`/`in_progress` (`meta` = `copy.statusTodo` or `copy.statusDoing`); section "Done" — `<List label={copy.doneList}>` rows for `done` (`meta` = `copy.statusDone`), omitted when none; then the add form. When `added !== null`: `<div data-testid="project-detail-success"><Notice tone="done" title={copy.added.replace("{title}", added)} live="status" /></div>` above the lists.
  - **Add form:** `<Form label={copy.formLabel} onSubmit={submit} busy={busy} actions={<button type="submit" className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" data-component="Button" disabled={busy}>{tasks.length === 0 ? copy.addFirst : copy.add}</button>}><TextInput id="project-task-title" label={copy.taskLabel} value={title} onChange={setTitle} error={fieldError} maxLength={200} required /></Form>`. `submit`: trimmed empty → `fieldError = copy.titleEmpty`, no call; else live `await create({ title, projectId, projectName: name })`, then clear the field and set `added = title`; a thrown error → `fieldError = copy.addFailed`. Forced mode: append `{ id: "local-<n>", title, status: "todo" }` to local state and set `added` (no Convex).

### TFV2-0142a — Pure helper: zoned day math (`apps/web/lib/zonedDay.ts`)
- **Stage:** B · **Pass:** 1 · **Depends:** none · **Folds-in:** none

- **WHY:** CONVENTIONS §14 (screens take the time zone from `userPreferences.timeZone` via `api.preferences.get`, never the browser's) — the Insights (TFV2-0142b) and Weekly page (TFV2-0148) screens need day and week windows in that zone; `apps/web/lib/localDay.ts` and `todayBounds.ts` only know the browser zone.
- **GOAL:** One pure module turns instants into calendar dates and calendar dates into midnights in any IANA time zone, and finds the start of a week for `weekStartsOn` 0, 1 or 6, proven by its own test.
- **SCOPE:** `apps/web/lib/zonedDay.ts` · test: `apps/web/lib/zonedDay.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `apps/web/lib/zonedDay.ts` (new) · `apps/web/lib/zonedDay.test.ts` (new).
- **STEPS:** 1) Code-map check: `ls apps/web/lib/zonedDay.ts` (absent); `grep -rn "zonedMidnightMs\|zonedIsoDate" apps/web` (no hits). 2) Create `zonedDay.ts` with exactly the SPEC code (no React, Next or Convex imports). 3) Create `zonedDay.test.ts` (`bun:test`) with the 7 TESTS cases. 4) Run DONE, then `bun run typecheck`.
- **DONE:** `bun test apps/web/lib/zonedDay.test.ts` → `7 pass`, `0 fail`; `bun run typecheck` → exit 0.
- **EVIDENCE:** the `bun test` summary and typecheck exit code pasted into the PR.
- **DO NOT:** edit `apps/web/lib/localDay.ts`, `todayBounds.ts`, `period-pages.ts` or `useLocalDayBounds.ts`; add a date library dependency; read `Date.now()` inside the module; touch `convex/**`, `.github/**`, `.env*`.
- **REPORT:** `status / ticket: TFV2-0142a / evidence: <DONE output> / changed: apps/web/lib/zonedDay.ts, apps/web/lib/zonedDay.test.ts / unknowns / notes for ticket sync`.
- **SPEC:** Pure module, exact code:
  ```ts
  export type WeekStartsOn = 0 | 1 | 6;

  function safeZone(timeZone: string): string {
    try {
      new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone });
      return timeZone;
    } catch {
      return "UTC";
    }
  }

  function zonedParts(ms: number, timeZone: string): Record<string, number> {
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
      timeZone: safeZone(timeZone), hourCycle: "h23",
      year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
    }).formatToParts(new Date(ms));
    const out: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const p of parts) if (p.type !== "literal") out[p.type] = Number(p.value);
    return out;
  }

  /** Offset of `timeZone` from UTC at instant `ms`, in ms (positive east of UTC). */
  function offsetMs(ms: number, timeZone: string): number {
    const p = zonedParts(ms, timeZone);
    const asUtc = Date.UTC(p.year, p.month - 1, p.day, p.hour, p.minute, p.second);
    return asUtc - Math.floor(ms / 1000) * 1000;
  }

  /** The calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of instant `ms` in `timeZone`; an unknown zone reads as "UTC". */
  export function zonedIsoDate(ms: number, timeZone: string): string {
    const p = zonedParts(ms, timeZone);
    return `${String(p.year).padStart(4, "0")}-${String(p.month).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(p.day).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }

  /** Epoch ms of 00:00 on `isoDate` in `timeZone`; an unknown zone reads as "UTC". */
  export function zonedMidnightMs(isoDate: string, timeZone: string): number {
    const [y, m, d] = isoDate.split("-").map(Number);
    const guess = Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d);
    const first = guess - offsetMs(guess, timeZone);
    const second = guess - offsetMs(first, timeZone);
    return second;
  }

  /** `isoDate` moved by `days` calendar days (no zone involved). */
  export function addIsoDays(isoDate: string, days: number): string {
    const [y, m, d] = isoDate.split("-").map(Number);
    return new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d + days)).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  /** Day of the week of a calendar date: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. */
  export function isoWeekday(isoDate: string): number {
    return new Date(`${isoDate}T00:00:00Z`).getUTCDay();
  }

  /** The first date of the week that holds `isoDate`, for a week starting on `weekStartsOn`. */
  export function weekStartDate(isoDate: string, weekStartsOn: WeekStartsOn): string {
    const back = (isoWeekday(isoDate) - weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
    return addIsoDays(isoDate, -back);
  }
  ```
  No user-facing copy; no errors thrown (an unknown zone falls back to `"UTC"`).
- **TESTS:** (`bun:test`, file `apps/web/lib/zonedDay.test.ts`)
  - Given `zonedIsoDate(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 12, 21, 30), "Asia/Jerusalem")` / Then `"2026-10-13"`; and with `"UTC"` / Then `"2026-10-12"`.
  - Given `zonedMidnightMs("2026-10-13", "Asia/Jerusalem")` / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 9, 12, 21, 0)`; and `zonedMidnightMs("2026-10-13", "UTC")` / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 9, 13)`.
  - Given the New York DST start (Sunday 8 March 2026) / When `zonedMidnightMs("2026-03-08", "America/New_York")` and `zonedMidnightMs("2026-03-09", "America/New_York")` run / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 2, 8, 5)` and `Date.UTC(2026, 2, 9, 4)`.
  - Given `zonedMidnightMs("2026-10-13", "Not/AZone")` / Then it equals `zonedMidnightMs("2026-10-13", "UTC")`, and `zonedIsoDate(0, "Not/AZone")` equals `"1970-01-01"`.
  - Given `addIsoDays("2026-10-31", 1)` / Then `"2026-11-01"`; and `addIsoDays("2026-03-01", -1)` / Then `"2026-02-28"`.
  - Given `isoWeekday("2026-10-15")` / Then `4`; and `isoWeekday("2026-10-11")` / Then `0`.
  - Given Thursday `"2026-10-15"` / When `weekStartDate` runs with 1, 0 and 6 / Then `"2026-10-12"`, `"2026-10-11"` and `"2026-10-10"`; and `weekStartDate("2026-10-12", 1)` / Then `"2026-10-12"`.
- **NUMBERS:** 7 of 7 cases pass (exact). No latency or UI number applies to a pure helper.
- **GATES:** 1 Build/typecheck/lint · 2 own TESTS green · 3 NUMBERS in range · 4 Google style formatting/naming · 5 secret + forbidden-tech scan · 6 scope guard · 7 config guard · 8 never weaken/skip/lower/delete a check · 9 Jev judge (typesafe/jev-1.13): instruction-following, formatting, naming, clean code each >= 0.85; a massive violation fails · 10 Process check: REPORT lists every STEP and DONE item with evidence; a missing item fails.

      | { status: "error"; query: string }
      | { status: "signed-out"; query: string }
      | { status: "no-results"; query: string }
      | { status: "ready"; query: string; results: SearchResults };

    .map((item) => item.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim())
    .filter((item) => item.length > 0)
    .slice(0, COACH_LIMITS.memoryItems);
  if (memory.length > 0) {
    const body = truncate(memory.map((item) => `- ${item}`).join("\n"), COACH_LIMITS.memoryChars);
    messages.push({ role: "system", content: `What they asked Tempo to remember about them.\n<memory>\n${body}\n</memory>` });
  }
  ```
  Order of system messages: role prompt → date line (when `today` is a real date) → `<page>` (when a page is open) → `<memory>` (when at least one non-blank memory) → `<tasks>` → web-search line → thread. Limits: at most `COACH_LIMITS.memoryItems` (10) items; the joined body at most `COACH_LIMITS.memoryChars` (2000) UTF-16 units, cut by the existing `truncate` (ends with "…", never splits a surrogate pair). The model-facing text is English only (it is a prompt, not UI copy). No errors thrown.

  - Given `memory: ["  ", "\n", "Real one"]` / When it runs / Then the memory message body lines are exactly `["- Real one"]`.
  - Given 12 memories `"m0"…"m11"` / When it runs / Then the memory message contains `"- m9"` and not `"- m10"`; and given 3 memories of 1,500 characters each / Then the text between `<memory>\n` and `\n</memory>` has length exactly 2000 and ends with `"…"`.

  import { z } from "zod";
  import { createTool } from "@convex-dev/agent";
  import { readProposal, type CoachProposal } from "../coachPrompt";

  export function createNoteProposal(args: { title: string; body: string }): NoteProposal | null {

  ```ts
  export type JobProposal = { kind: "job"; cron: string; task: string; targetPageType: "daily" | "weekly" | "project" | "plain" };
  /** One cron field: "*", a number, a range "a-b", a list "a,b", each optionally "/step"; digits and * , - / only. */
  export const CRON_FIELD = /^(\*|\d+(-\d+)?)(\/\d+)?(,(\*|\d+(-\d+)?)(\/\d+)?)*$/;
  /** Exactly 5 space-separated fields, each matching CRON_FIELD, minute 0–59, hour 0–23, day 1–31, month 1–12, weekday 0–6 for every number. */
  export function isFiveFieldCron(cron: string): boolean;
  /** null when the cron is not five valid fields, the task is blank after trimming, or targetPageType is not one of the four. Task ≤ 200 (truncate). */
  export function scheduleJobProposal(args: { cron: string; task: string; targetPageType: string }): JobProposal | null;
  export const scheduleJobTool = createTool({
    description: "Propose a recurring job. Cron is five fields in UTC. Nothing runs until the person approves it.",
    args: z.object({ cron: z.string(), task: z.string(), targetPageType: z.enum(["daily", "weekly", "project", "plain"]) }),
    handler: async (_ctx, args): Promise<{ proposal: JobProposal | null }> => ({ proposal: scheduleJobProposal(args) }),
  });
  ```
  Auth as TFV2-0156. No error thrown; no user-facing copy (the job card is TFV2-0216).
- **TESTS:**
  - Given `scheduleJobProposal({ cron: "0 6 * * 1-5", task: "Plan my day", targetPageType: "daily" })` / Then it equals `{ kind: "job", cron: "0 6 * * 1-5", task: "Plan my day", targetPageType: "daily" }`.
  - Given cron `"every weekday at 8"` / Then `null`.
  - Given cron `"0 6 * *"` (four fields) and `"60 6 * * *"` (minute out of range) / Then both `null`.
  - Given task `"  "` / Then `null`.
  - Given `targetPageType: "monthly"` / Then `null`.
- **NUMBERS:** 5 of 5 cases pass (exact); cron fields within POSIX ranges (minute 0–59, hour 0–23, day 1–31, month 1–12, weekday 0–6; source: POSIX `crontab` specification, https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9799919799/utilities/crontab.html).
